blocks.text: Statistical modeling data se duniya ko samajhne aur mustaqbil ka andaza lagane ka tareeqa hai. Aise sochein: agar aap jaanna chahte hain ke agle mahine grocery par kitne paise lagenge, to aap pichhle kharche dekhenge. Us data ka jaiza le kar aap ek model bana sakte hain jo aane wale grocery kharche ka andaza lagaye.

Misal: Agar aap aam taur par har mahine taqreeban 10,000 rupay kharch karte hain lekin kharcha upar neeche hota rehta hai, to statistical model khandan ke size ya khaas mauqon (special occasions) jaise awamil (factors) bhi shamil kar sakta hai. Is tarah agle mahine ke grocery budget ka behtar andaza lagta hai.

blocks.prompt: Grocery ke model mein kaunse awamil (factors) shamil ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Pichhla kharcha, khandan ka size, jagah (location), aamdani aur khaas mauqe.

items: Statistical modeling: purane data se seekh kar pesh-goi (maslan agle mahine ka grocery bill).
